testIds: tests/plugin-worker-v3.test.ts::M13-C01 validates PluginManifestV2 strictly and rejects undeclared capability shapes
tests/plugin-lifecycle-v3.test.ts::M13 isolated package admission > admits a pinned installed package carrying isolated.json and binds the verified digest
requirements.reason: PluginManifestV2: pluginId, version, packageDigest, protocolVersion, declaredCapabilities, toolSchemas, dataNamespace, executionProfileRef and lifecycle hooks as a strict contract. The package-side isolated.json omits host-owned identity; the host binds the verified inventory digest and protocolVersion=1. Trusted apiVersion-1 plug-ins stay explicitly trusted or disabled; nothing converts them implicitly.

testIds: tests/plugin-worker-v3.test.ts::M13-C02 validates PluginLeaseV1 states and bounded calls
tests/plugin-lifecycle-v3.test.ts::M13 leased lifecycle
requirements.reason: PluginLeaseV1: pluginId, version, generation, ownerScopes, activeCalls, registrations and STARTING|ACTIVE|DRAINING|STOPPED|FAILED|UNKNOWN. Every frame carries generation and a bounded 32-bit request id; the lease revokes all registrations at once.

testIds: tests/plugin-worker-v3.test.ts::M13-C03 validates WorkerFrameV1 kinds and rejects extras
tests/plugin-worker-v3.test.ts::WorkerFrameV1 codec
tests/plugin-protocol-decisions-v6.test.ts::M13-D01
requirements.reason: WorkerFrameV1: protocolVersion=1, requestId, generation, kind, payload over a 4-byte unsigned LE length prefix plus UTF-8 JSON on private host-created pipes. Kinds HELLO, READY, REQUEST, RESPONSE, CANCEL, SHUTDOWN, BYE, ERROR. Length >1 MiB rejected before allocation; 32 in-flight bound; 10 s handshake deadline; 5 s shutdown grace.

testIds: tests/plugin-worker-v3.test.ts::real worker process over private pipes > launches the real worker entry, handshakes and serves a bounded request
requirements.reason: Trusted V1 host APIs inventoried and untouched; the worker activation context is frozen {dataDir, genVersion} only - no Store, credential manager, native runtime object or generic command client crosses the boundary. Frames are schema-checked JSON; a frame cannot carry a host capability. The real-entry test asserts the activated context key set.

testIds: tests/plugin-lifecycle-v3.test.ts::M13 isolated package admission
requirements.reason: admitIsolatedPackage reuses the existing installer owner verifyPluginPackage for canonical paths, declared inventory and digest equality, then reads the optional isolated.json declaration bound to the verified manifest identity. Only an installed pinned package directory is admitted: no archive upload, install script, network download or unresolved dependency is created by this task.

testIds: tests/plugin-protocol-decisions-v6.test.ts::M13-D05
tests/plugin-lifecycle-v3.test.ts::M13 activation gate
requirements.reason: Launch through a proven M03 profile: the spawn launcher supplies only the private dataDir, declared capabilities and the processEnvironment allowlist over authenticated private pipes, but production confinement is the backend's ApprovedLaunch and this host has no installed approved backend with a current PASS proof. Activation fails closed with HOLD_BACKEND_SELECTION / HOLD_PLATFORM_PROOF; a working IPC channel is never reported as confinement.

testIds: tests/plugin-lifecycle-v3.test.ts::M13 leased lifecycle > activates STARTING->ACTIVE, registers declared tools and serves dispatch
tests/plugin-lifecycle-v3.test.ts::M13 leased lifecycle > rejects a worker claiming undeclared operations
requirements.reason: Tools/UI register as lease rows tied to the worker generation; READY operations not declared by the manifest are a protocol violation. dispatch() mediates every invocation through the active lease's tool registrations; a worker cannot self-grant or promote a hidden schema.

testIds: tests/plugin-lifecycle-v3.test.ts::M13 leased lifecycle > update drains the old generation before publishing the new one
tests/plugin-lifecycle-v3.test.ts::M13 leased lifecycle > leaves the previous package and namespace intact when the new generation fails
requirements.reason: Update = prepare (manifest parse + identity check), validate (migration plan when declared), drain (registrations revoked, bounded settlement, late replies rejected), swap, revoke. The new generation is published only after confirmed old-generation termination; on new-generation failure the previous manifest/package/data pointers are restored. Old package and data are preserved for explicit rollback.

testIds: tests/plugin-lifecycle-v3.test.ts::M13 leased lifecycle > unconfirmed termination reports UNKNOWN and never starts a replacement
tests/plugin-protocol-decisions-v6.test.ts::M13-D04
tests/plugin-lifecycle-v3.test.ts::M13 leased lifecycle > disable drains, confirms teardown and reports STOPPED with retained data
requirements.reason: Disable revokes registrations before settling calls and reports STOPPED only after the exact owned process tree is confirmed gone. Unconfirmed termination yields UNKNOWN and blocks any replacement with an overlapping writable namespace.

testIds: tests/plugin-lifecycle-v3.test.ts::M13 leased lifecycle > blocks a migration-needing update without a complete approved plan
requirements.reason: PluginMigrationPlanV1 requires planId, immutable input/output versions matching the installed and next manifests, a backup digest, the exact migration executable digest and a post-validation receipt. A migration-needing update without the complete contract returns MIGRATION_PLAN_REQUIRED and leaves the old package/data untouched; no migration code is invented or run with host privileges.

testIds: tests/plugin-lifecycle-v3.test.ts::M13 leased lifecycle > catalog merges trusted and isolated rows with state, digest and block reason
requirements.reason: Extension views flow through the existing /api/plugins catalog contract; no worker contribution injects host-document scripts, arbitrary HTML/CSS or fabricated operation approvals. The trusted PluginFrame sandbox (opaque origin, CSP) is unchanged.

worker.py line 222 keeps config["plugins"] = {"enabled": False}; the M13 bundle does not unlock ambient Hermes plugins. Verified by source inspection at the execution cut; the flag was not modified and no Hermes adapter was admitted.

testIds: tests/plugin-worker-v3.test.ts::fails pending calls when the worker exits
tests/plugin-lifecycle-v3.test.ts::drops late old-generation replies after update without publication
tests/plugin-protocol-decisions-v6.test.ts::M13-D02
requirements.reason: Crash (worker exit rejects pending calls), flood (32-request in-flight bound), stale-generation and malformed-data fixtures run in the lifecycle and protocol suites. Isolation and lifecycle proof are recorded separately: a working IPC channel is not advertised as an OS security guarantee, and the data-access confinement fixture stays BLOCKED under M13-D05.

testIds: tests/plugin-lifecycle-v3.test.ts::M13 leased lifecycle > catalog merges trusted and isolated rows with state, digest and block reason
requirements.reason: The existing extension surface gains an Extensions menu: each row identifies Trusted host extension versus Isolated extension, exact version, truncated digest, declared capabilities, private data scope and runtime state.

testIds: tests/plugin-lifecycle-v3.test.ts::M13 leased lifecycle > blocks a migration-needing update without a complete approved plan
requirements.reason: updatePreview identifies capability expansion and required data migration before any drain; blocked updates carry MIGRATION_PLAN_REQUIRED. The catalog row shows Draining during teardown, retained-data status and the update-block reason; the rollback decision stays host-owned and is surfaced as retained-data state rather than a fake control.

testIds: tests/plugin-lifecycle-v3.test.ts::M13 leased lifecycle
requirements.reason: Worker errors are sanitized bounded strings that never carry host paths, stack text or secrets; each failure is scoped to its plugin record and lease, so other healthy extensions keep running.

testIds: tests/plugin-protocol-decisions-v6.test.ts::M13-D05
requirements.reason: Protected DB/credential reads, out-of-root writes and network access must be attempted under the actual selected backend; this host supplies no installed approved backend with a current PASS proof, so the real-confinement cases stay BLOCKED rather than mocked.

testIds: tests/plugin-protocol-decisions-v6.test.ts::M13-D01
tests/plugin-protocol-decisions-v6.test.ts::M13-D02
tests/plugin-worker-v3.test.ts::WorkerFrameV1 codec
requirements.reason: Malformed and oversized frames, invalid UTF-8, unknown kinds, duplicate or unknown request ids and more than 32 concurrent calls are rejected or bounded before dispatch.

testIds: tests/plugin-protocol-decisions-v6.test.ts::M13-D03
tests/plugin-lifecycle-v3.test.ts::drops late old-generation replies after update without publication
requirements.reason: Late old-generation replies after update cannot resolve a new-generation call, mutate host state or re-register tools; the catalog is byte-identical before and after the stale delivery.

testIds: tests/plugin-lifecycle-v3.test.ts::leaves the previous package and namespace intact when the new generation fails
tests/plugin-lifecycle-v3.test.ts::blocks a migration-needing update without a complete approved plan
requirements.reason: Failed startup, migration-blocked update and new-generation failure leave the original manifest/package/data pointers intact and no partially active registry: registrations are revoked first and the FAILED/UNKNOWN lease admits no new writable generation.

testIds: tests/plugin-lifecycle-v3.test.ts::revokes new calls while a busy plug-in unloads and confirms cleanup
tests/plugin-lifecycle-v3.test.ts::unconfirmed termination reports UNKNOWN and never starts a replacement
requirements.reason: Unloading a busy plug-in revokes new calls (dispatch rejects while DRAINING), settles or rejects in-flight work through drain/shutdown, and confirms process cleanup before STOPPED; unconfirmed teardown yields UNKNOWN.

testIds: tests/plugin-lifecycle-v3.test.ts::M13 activation gate
tests/plugin-protocol-decisions-v6.test.ts::M13-D05
requirements.reason: Untrusted activation requires exactly one installed approved backend id plus a current-platform PASS proof via selectBackend/hasCurrentPlatformProof; zero or ambiguous identities hold as HOLD_BACKEND_SELECTION/HOLD_PLATFORM_PROOF. Existing plug-ins stay explicitly trusted; nothing rebrands them.

testIds: tests/plugin-lifecycle-v3.test.ts::M13 activation gate > stays disabled while plugins.isolatedV1 is off
requirements.reason: plugins.isolatedV1 was added to the existing host-owned registry (M13_FLAG_KEYS plus CapabilityFlagKey union and hostDefinitions) without replacing any registered key; it defaults off, is host-configured only, and is absent from strict UI preferences. Each risky sub-capability keeps its own proof.

testIds: tests/plugin-lifecycle-v3.test.ts::leaves the previous package and namespace intact when the new generation fails
tests/plugin-protocol-decisions-v6.test.ts::M13-D04
requirements.reason: Rollback revokes new-generation registrations, stops owned workers and restores the last validated manifest/package/data pointers only after confirming no overlapping writer (unconfirmed drain yields UNKNOWN and blocks activation). Audit history is per-record and trust is never loosened to make a plug-in load.

testIds: tests/plugin-protocol-decisions-v6.test.ts::M13-D01 framing bounds: 1 MiB is schema-checked; 1 MiB+1 announced is rejected before allocation
requirements.reason: A 1 MiB frame is fully read and schema-checked; a 1 MiB+1 announced length is rejected at the 4-byte header before payload allocation.

testIds: tests/plugin-protocol-decisions-v6.test.ts::M13-D02 inflight cap: 32 outstanding; the 33rd is BUSY without dispatch; one settlement re-admits
requirements.reason: 32 outstanding requests admitted; the 33rd raises PLUGIN_BUSY with no REQUEST frame dispatched; one settlement re-admits a new request.

testIds: tests/plugin-protocol-decisions-v6.test.ts::M13-D03 stale reply: an old-generation response after update causes no host mutation or UI publication
requirements.reason: An old-generation RESPONSE/READY delivered after update cannot resolve a new-generation call or publish registrations; the catalog is unchanged.

testIds: tests/plugin-protocol-decisions-v6.test.ts::M13-D04 drain failure: unconfirmed process termination yields UNKNOWN and no new writable worker starts
requirements.reason: When old process-tree termination cannot be confirmed the lease becomes UNKNOWN and activate() rejects any new writable worker for the namespace.

testIds: tests/plugin-protocol-decisions-v6.test.ts::M13-D05 real confinement is not satisfiable without a proven installed backend
requirements.reason: Protected DB/credential reads, out-of-root writes and network access must run under the actual approved backend. None exists on this host (M03 evidence already records BLOCKED), so the case is held: the lane fails closed with HOLD_BACKEND_SELECTION and the hold is asserted, never mocked as a pass.
